execution: in-session. Orchestration is one unit: it moves no data, so there is nothing to fan out and nothing to reconcile.
why_no_recon: p3-orchestration writes no table. Its evidence is the deployed job graph read back from the workspace API, recorded in docs/migration/Pipeline3_schedule_model.md, not a row comparison.
scope: every pipeline-3 schedule converted from etl/crontab and the analytics-service Helm CronJob
the dependency edges between the five jobs
retry, concurrency, queueing and timeout settings
the schedule-model document pipeline 3 inherits from pipeline 2

invariants.paused: Every schedule is PAUSED in the resource definition and again by the target's trigger_pause_status preset. Verified against the deployed jobs, not just the YAML.
invariants.no_clusters: No job_clusters, no new_cluster, no existing_cluster_id, no spark_jar_task. Every executable task runs on the serverless environment.
invariants.one_starter_per_pipeline: Pipeline 3 defines no Lakeflow pipeline at all, so no two jobs can start the same pipeline update. Where one job needs another's output it uses run_job_task on the owning job (user_activity -> analytics_daily), which queues behind the owner instead of racing it.
invariants.retries_on_owning_tasks: max_retries/min_retry_interval_millis/retry_on_timeout sit on the tasks that do the work. Nothing is asserted on the run_job_task, because Databricks drops task-level retry policy there.
invariants.no_production_target: The bundle has one target, migration. There is no prod or production target to deploy by accident.
invariants.on_violation: A halt reported to the parent, never reconciled around.

deployed_evidence.no_job_for: search_reindex_weekly.py (P3-D05, declared coverage gap, deliberately absent)

stop_e_inputs: Sunday 04:00 search_reindex_weekly.py has no converted schedule: the job stays service-side and its schedule stays where it is.
The usage rollup's nightly 02:00 Helm CronJob is converted, but nothing in this estate consumes its output (F-0.6). Whether it should run at all is a user question.
Every schedule is PAUSED. Activating them is a cutover action with the customer's principal, never a child session's.
